nodes.label: GitHub Issue Hierarchy (Feature → Story → Task)
nodes.description: Work tracked on WatchAtlas GitHub Project v2 board. Feature → Story → Task hierarchy via native sub-issues. Exactly one type: label per issue. Status: Backlog → Ready → In progress → In review → Done. Tasks created during coding sessions (lazy)

nodes.label: Commit & PR Convention
nodes.description: Every change maps to a GitHub issue. Commits/PRs reference issue (Fixes #12) so it auto-links and auto-closes. No uncaptured work

nodes.label: Architecture Rule: TMDB Proxy Only
nodes.description: TMDB access only via internal proxy routes pages/api/tmdb/*. Never call TMDB from client or expose key. Server-only TMDB_API_KEY is the target. Don't add uses of NEXT_PUBLIC_TMDB_API_KEY

nodes.label: Architecture Rule: Named Firestore Database
nodes.description: Firestore is a named database: getFirestore(app, 'watchatlaspreference'). Keep using it; default database is empty and must stay unused

nodes.label: Architecture Rule: Cache Control Headers
nodes.description: API routes must set Cache-Control: s-maxage headers. Preserve or consciously adjust when touching routes

nodes.label: Architecture Rule: Tailwind + CSS Variables
nodes.description: Styling: Tailwind v4 + CSS-variable system in styles/globals.css (dark default, .light overrides). Follow existing variables rather than hardcoding colors

nodes.label: Architecture Rule: AppLayout is Live Shell
nodes.description: components/NavBar.tsx is dead code — don't extend it. AppLayout.tsx is the live shell
